## Publish Listing

The single writer for a property listing’s go-live: a listing may not publish half-dressed — address, asking price, and at least one photo are enforced (photo-less listings do not get viewings). Later lifecycle moves are status edits; the publish moment never rewrites.

### Example

Natural target: the linked 14 Birchwood Lane (already live — re-running demonstrates the once-only guard).

### Non-goals

No portal syndication, no scheduled publishing.

### Channels and scheduling

Input carries `channels[]` (vocabulary in components/channel-selector; MLS always unioned in) and `scheduledDate`. Publishing is simulated (2–3s beat, mock `MLS-########`, per-channel success rows with example.com links); the result carries `channelResults[]` (`resultStatus`, not a nested `status`, because a nested field named `status` inherits the root card's status configuration), `mlsNumber`, `publishedAtIso`, `scheduled`. Draft OR prepared may publish; a future `scheduledDate` records intent and patches nothing (a realm has no background scheduler — rerun after the time).
